sample_unit: questions (each translated into 3 languages, plus English)

links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM answers to cirrhosis questions by patient language (English, Korean, Mandarin, Spanish)
links.effect: GPT-4 had significantly higher proportions of comprehensive and correct answers than ChatGPT in all four languages (p<0.05). ChatGPT produced erroneous non-English responses. The quality gap between English and non-English answers was smaller with GPT-4.
links.quote: GPT-4 showed a marked improvement in the proportion of comprehensive and correct answers compared to ChatGPT across all four languages (p<0.05).

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance (GPT-4 vs ChatGPT) across multiple languages for cirrhosis-related health literacy questions without evaluating a specific organizational deployment safeguard.
